_about: Heroes button (HeroesScene, user's pick C: docs/proposals/menu/hero-page-variations.png right + glossary-heroes-spaced.png). LIST = 2-column grid (locked = shadow, short goal, progress bar). HERO PAGE = card: 'your pixel art' box on top (user's art later), the hero big on the dungeon floor with name + role, the look name (looks = skins, one 'CLASSIC' each for now) + dots, HP/ATK/DEF/RES strip, LORE and STATS. STATS = RECORDS (this hero's runs, kept from session 37 on) / KIT (skills, perk, passive). lore = 2-3 lines per hero (draft, user to review). shortGoals = the unlock goal in a list tile. shortNames = names too long for a list tile.

lore.knight: Once the captain of Soldia's gate. When the gate fell to the things below, the Knight walked down into the dark to finish the fight in person.
lore.berserker: Thrown out of three war camps for starting fights. The dungeon is the first place that never asks for calm.
lore.rogue: Stole one coin too many from the wrong lord. Down here nobody checks a purse, and the treasure has no owners left.
lore.archer: A hunter from the forest around the tower. When the beasts of the woods began crawling out of the dungeon, the hunt moved underground.
lore.samurai: A wandering blade bound by an old master's last order: one perfect cut, at the bottom of the deepest dungeon.
lore.mage: Fire, ice and storm in one stubborn student. Expelled for melting the academy library; down here, only monsters are left to burn.
lore.cleric: A healer from the chapel of the dawn. Where the light does not reach, someone has to carry it.
lore.necromancer: Studied death to stop it, and learned to borrow it instead. The bones down here answer to a gentle voice.
lore.bard: Sings the songs of every squad that never came back, and means to write a better ending.
lore.alchemist: Every bottle is an experiment, and every experiment explodes. Down here, that is a feature.
